_comment: Hand-verified person -> VC firm links. Each one was checked by eye; none
were inferred from a role string.
A heuristic pass proposed Marc Benioff -> Salesforce Ventures and Eric
Schmidt -> Google Ventures. Both are wrong: they ran the parent company and
were never partners at the fund. Linking them would have attributed a fund's
record to a person who never worked there. Hence this file.
Skipped deliberately: Naval Ravikant (AngelList), Jason Calacanis (LAUNCH),
Travis Kalanick (10100) and Bill Ackman (Pershing Square) are real investors
whose vehicles are not tracked funds here, so there is nothing to link to.
The link is navigation only. A partner's grade and the firm's are computed
from their own receipts and neither inherits the other's.

63.who: Steven Sinofsky -> Andreessen Horowitz (board partner, per his own role)

59.who: Keith Rabois -> Khosla Ventures (returned 2024 after Founders Fund)
